from.place: proper-flat support proof: lift a pseudo-coherent representative from the quasi-compact open to a bounded-above finite-free complex on the affine scheme

title: Pseudo-coherent complexes lift from a quasi-compact open of an affine scheme
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and U a quasi-compact open subscheme of X. For every pseudo-coherent object E of D(\mathcal O_U) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], there exists a bounded-above complex of finite free \mathcal O_X-modules whose restriction to U is isomorphic to E in D(\mathcal O_U).

proof.text: Package E as a quasi-coherent derived object using pseudo-coherent quasi-coherence. Apply the existing quasi-compact open derived lift to obtain E prime on X and its restriction isomorphism to E.

Construct T as tilde over Gamma(X) followed by restriction along X.isoSpec.hom. Choose standard module derived categories for the localizations. Apply the affine-open module comparison to E prime and E to obtain M, a finite family of pseudo-coherent localizations, a derived representation isomorphism, and detection of localized quasi-isomorphisms on U.
Apply the finite-localization free-model lemma to M and the family to obtain bounded-above finite-free F and a map alpha whose localizations are quasi-isomorphisms.

Set P=T(F) termwise. T preserves zero objects, so the strict upper bound of F gives the upper bound of P. Choose a finite basis of each F term, reindex by ULift(Fin r), and apply tildeFinsupp and mapFreeIso for restriction, using restrictUnitIso. This gives an isomorphism of each P term with a finite free structure-sheaf module.

The detection clause makes the derived restriction of Q(T alpha) invertible. Compose its asIso with the restricted isomorphism Q(T M) isomorphic to E prime and the lift isomorphism E prime restricted to U isomorphic to E. This is the required derived isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem exists_boundedAbove_finiteFree_lift (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))] (E : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) (hE : IsPseudoCoherent U.toScheme E) : ∃ P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ, (∃ N : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, N < i → IsZero (P.X i)) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (P.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) ∧ Nonempty (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U) ⋙ Equivalence.functor (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) (Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅ E)
